Class SocialNetworkService

      public SocialNetworkService(Repository<Long,User> userRepository, Repository<FriendshipId,Friendship> friendshipRepository, Validator<User> userValidator, Validator<Friendship> friendshipValidator, CommunityAnalyzer communityAnalyzer)
      Creates a social network service.
      Parameters:
      userRepository - user storage
      friendshipRepository - friendship storage
      userValidator - user validation strategy
      friendshipValidator - friendship validation strategy
      communityAnalyzer - graph analysis
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any dependency is null
